realm.name: github-caller
realm.description: May use agent2's GitHub function. Checked by agent1 before it requests the github.act scope in the token exchange.

clients.description: Used only by the break-it button

clientScopes.name: roles
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add user roles to the access token

clientScopes.name: basic
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add all basic claims to the token

clientScopes.name: service_account
clientScopes.description: Specific scope for a client enabled for service accounts

clientScopes.name: github.act
clientScopes.description: Marks a token as carrying the caller's permission to use agent2's GitHub function. Only granted to users with the github-caller realm role.

clientScopes.name: actor.agent1
clientScopes.description: Adds a hardcoded act claim naming agent1. Only agent1 gets this scope.

clientScopes.name: web-origins
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add allowed web origins to the access token

clientScopes.name: acr
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add acr (authentication context class reference) to the token

clientScopes.name: organization
clientScopes.description: Additional claims about the organization a subject belongs to

clientScopes.name: agent2-audience
clientScopes.description: Adds the agent2 audience. Requested on every exchange to agent2, regardless of whether the user has github.act - audience (who the token is for) and scope (what it is allowed to do there) are kept separate on purpose.
